title: HF493 (2025-2026 Regular): Firearms transfer to persons who are ineligible to possess firearms prohibition modified.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-02-11; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/493/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2025-02-11. No votes recorded. The bill strikes coverage of 'any other firearm' (narrowing the ban to pistols and semiautomatic military-style assault weapons) and strikes the exception for other firearms to persons under 18. Section 2 repeals subd. 4 (affirmative defense for a household member acting under compulsion).

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 1): A person is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for up to two years and to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000 if the person intentionally transfers a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to another and the person knows or reasonably should know that the transferee:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 1): (1) has been denied a permit to carry under section 624.714 because the transferee is not eligible under section 624.713 to possess a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon;
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 1): (2) has been found ineligible to possess a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon by a chief of police or sheriff as a result of an application for a transferee permit or a transfer report; or
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 1): (3) is disqualified under section 624.713 from possessing a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon.
